_comment: Stub metadata for the marvell-prestera-psai-vs single-asic KVM image. Consumed by sonic_platform.chassis.Chassis (from sonic-platform-modules-vs) at module import. Single-asic VS images do not call get_supervisor_slot()/get_linecard_slot()/get_my_slot(), but is_supervisor/is_linecard are kept here so any future caller observes a sane 'standalone, not a chassis' configuration instead of a KeyError.
